issue.title: Add a static durability lint (QC001-QC006) to workflow validate and execute
issue.body:
## Summary

`workflow validate` runs `tsc` and imports the module but never inspects the workflow body, so replay hazards such as branching on `existsSync`, `Date.now()` in step input, `Promise.race` over durable calls, nested durable calls and reused literal IDs all pass validation.
